# Requirements Document

## Introduction

Dispatch rules of the planted fixture, added for the precision-fix checks. Not part of the real project.

## Requirements

### Requirement 1: Lanes

**User Story:** As a dispatcher, I want lanes kept small, so that bundles move fast.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. The dispatcher SHALL cap each lane at 12 bundles.
2. WHEN a lane is sealed, the dispatcher SHALL hand every bundle to the night courier.
